replace.grasp_plan:
Generate inspectable public RGB-D grasp candidates for one current target.
Use when: current grounding or segmentation identifies the intended object and you need parallel-jaw poses.
Effect: read-only; queries Contact-GraspNet using the selected source-camera RGB-D and compiles poses to the public TCP convention. Optional synchronized views provide review evidence.
Returns: up to three candidates, complete world-frame pregrasp_pose and contact_pose, copyable bounded contact_approach targets, predicted opening, compiler checks and labeled review images. Reachability is delegated to move_pose. Inspect every candidate panel and choose target identity and geometry independently of rank. For this atomic surface, command the selected pregrasp_pose with move_pose, then read the receipt and fresh observation before approaching or closing with set_gripper. Re-plan candidates after any world action. Pose handoff: when manually commanding a returned world pose, set position_mode=absolute and orientation_mode=absolute_quaternion, then copy position_m and orientation_xyzw unchanged. Send these fields at the top level. Choose interaction by the intended physical contact. Schema example only; replace the illustrative pose and arm with your selected current result:
{"tool":"move_pose","arguments":{"position_mode":"absolute","position_m":[0.1,0.0,0.9],"orientation_mode":"absolute_quaternion","orientation_xyzw":[0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0],"interaction":"precision"}}
Does not: plan trajectories, certify reachability, move the robot, command a gripper, use object ground truth, certify retention or report task success. Backend rank is not a success probability. Missing optional review cameras do not invalidate usable primary input.
On error: obtain a better current view or select another target or candidate. Recompute after the target or observation changes. After a submitted motion fails, use its phase and measured residual to choose the next action. Retention evidence remains advisory.
replace.place_plan:
Propose a bounded, numeric next placement step from selected current public RGB-D regions.
Use when: a retained object is near a visible destination and you need a preplace, lower, or short exit candidate. Select object_ref, then name the destination as flat fields: destination_kind, destination_support_ref, and destination_boundary_ref for open_container or front_cavity, which is refused by name when it is missing there and when it is supplied for support_surface. A whole-container centroid is not its cavity. Re-localize after every physical action.
Effect: read-only with respect to the world; creates an immutable observation-bound assessment, measured geometry and overlay. It consumes no robot decision, executes no motion and changes no action admission state. The original mask and depth are preserved as immutable evidence. In this placement-only projection, boundary discontinuity pixels are flagged uncertain, not certified background; the original depth remains available for inspection.
Returns: candidates, no_candidate or unknown with at most three one-step world-pose candidates, checks, stage evidence and hashed public evidence. On this atomic surface, command one selected current candidate with move_pose; release separately with set_gripper only after inspecting fresh evidence. After each world action, re-observe and re-plan. Pose handoff: when manually commanding a returned world pose, set position_mode=absolute and orientation_mode=absolute_quaternion, then copy position_m and orientation_xyzw unchanged. Send these fields at the top level. Choose interaction by the intended physical contact. Schema example only; replace the illustrative pose and arm with your selected current result:
{"tool":"move_pose","arguments":{"position_mode":"absolute","position_m":[0.1,0.0,0.9],"orientation_mode":"absolute_quaternion","orientation_xyzw":[0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0],"interaction":"precision"}}
assessment_ref is an audit reference, never an executable trajectory. Inspect the reported depth-edge uncertainty: all retained points still face unchanged support/opening tests. When boundary evidence is unresolved, candidates are conditional on unresolved silhouette, not full-object fit, passage or release certificates.
Does not: prove object identity, grasp attachment, stable support, physical release or official success; infer hidden cavity volume; or certify a collision-free scene/payload trajectory. CuRobo remains world:none. No visible conflict is not collision-free. upright uses a fit to the selected visible circular rim, not a PCA cup axis; absent/invalid rim evidence stays unknown. Each protected_before_refs and protected_current_refs entry at the same index is an Agent association, not identity authentication. A boundary depth gap cannot distinguish leaked background from a true farther surface or thin handle; flagged pixels remain unresolved evidence, not semantic background exclusions.
On error: inspect fresh complementary RGB-D and reselect functional regions; do not replace missing geometry with a guessed center or stale candidate. Retention checks supply advisory geometric evidence; decide closed-gripper motion from fresh observations and the reported uncertainty. For manual placement, inspect before release, release as a separate action, inspect after release and inspect again after a short departure. Use the advertised place_verify for placement evidence at each relevant current state. Each check is evidence for Agent judgment, not an automatic release or success authorization. geometry_status and measured checks are separate from stage_evidence and uncertainty_reasons. Unconfirmed action stage preserves valid geometric candidates; inspect their prerequisites and decide subsequent actions independently.
replace.set_gripper:
Set the gripper to a named directive.
Use when: you are opening to release or approach, or closing to grasp, and you already know which directive each gripper should hold. This embodiment has one arm, so the directive needs no arm name. For manual grasp or placement, complete and inspect the required pose action before issuing the gripper-only command; this call does not execute a returned pose or candidate.
Effect: submits one gripper directive per named gripper through the Supervisor and consumes one robot decision. The end-effector pose target is held unchanged. Measured state may still move under contact, and that is evidence rather than a fault.
Returns: a submitted acknowledgement, then a measured receipt and a fresh observation on the next turn. When closing, an intent block echoes the target_ref you supplied and labels it agent_annotation_only.
Does not: prove anything was grasped, held, released or moved; report jaw separation; verify what the jaws closed on; or make target_ref evidence -- it is your annotation of what you believe you are closing on, never a measurement. A closed jaw is not a grasp.
On error: invalid_motion_arguments names the field that was wrong -- re-read this schema rather than resubmitting the same shape. invalid_arguments naming target_ref means a blank string was sent; send a non-empty reference or omit it entirely.
